featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an awesome time at Timezone in Capital Mall, Vasai East. The VR ride was truly out of this world. I chose the Halloween game, and it was so immersive and spooky. I felt like. The VR headset and equipment were super clean and comfortable, and the whole setup was well maintained. Each ride lasted about 10 minutes, which was just the right length for me. At ₹200 per person per ride, it's a bit on the pricier side, but the experience is definitely worth it.

The VR rides were the highlight of our visit, but the arcade games were also fun and engaging. The bowling alley, though small, was still enjoyable, and I had a good time. The only downside was that the place can get quite crowded, especially on weekends, and the AC sometimes struggles to keep up

Despite the occasional crowd and warm temperatures, I had a great time at Timezone Capital Mall
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Ranajit, we’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the immersive VR experience and had a fun visit! Your feedback about the crowd and temperature is appreciated, as we’re always looking to improve. Thank you for sharing your thoughts, and we hope to see you again soon for more adventures!

featured_reviews.name: SP Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Angel Game Zone is a newly opened indoor play area in Evershine City that offers a safe and enjoyable environment for young children. While the space is currently on the compact side, it still manages to provide a fun and engaging experience for kids. Since it is relatively new, the play zone has a good foundation, and there is clear potential for expansion with more toys and activities in the future.
One of the standout aspects of this place is the staff. The attendants are attentive, friendly, and genuinely caring toward the children. They actively supervise the kids during playtime, ensuring both safety and comfort, which gives parents a sense of reassurance. It’s evident that the team puts effort into maintaining a welcoming and secure atmosphere.
Another advantage of Angel Game Zone is that it offers attractive deals for hosting birthday parties. For parents looking for a convenient and kid-friendly venue to celebrate special occasions, this can be a practical option. The setup is simple but suitable for small gatherings, especially for younger children.
Overall, Angel Game Zone is a promising addition to the area. Although the play space is currently limited in size and variety, the quality of care provided by the staff and the potential for growth make it worth visiting. With time and added features, it could become a popular destination for families in Vasai East.

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Thrillville with a group of friends and we had the time of our lives. The Slip 'n' Strike (soapy football) was hilarious and fun, and the 9D Odyssey was a cool experience. There's also a great kids' zone (WOW Kids) which is perfect if you’re coming with family. It’s budget-friendly, especially with the 5-activity combo. Will definitely be coming back!

featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited ThrillVille Entertainment Zone yesterday. While the overall concept of the place is good, we felt that several areas need much better maintenance, hygiene, and customer attention.

The go-karting experience was decent, but many of the cars did not seem to be maintained properly, which affected both the experience and the safety aspect.

Similarly, during the Splash Waterpark adventure, the water had a very unpleasant fishy smell and did not appear clean or regularly maintained. Hygiene is extremely important in water-based activities, and this was quite disappointing.

Another major concern was the staff behavior at the Splash Waterpark adventure area. Instead of actively supervising and assisting children, some staff members appeared more occupied enjoying themselves and were not attentive to kids who were struggling to climb back onto the adventure setup from the water. It felt like there was very little concern or support being provided, which was disappointing from a safety and customer service perspective.

Considering the amount charged for these activities, we expected a much better standard of upkeep, cleanliness, and staff involvement. Proper maintenance, regular cleaning, and more responsible staff supervision would greatly improve the overall experience.

Unfortunately, this visit did not meet our expectations, and personally, I may not consider visiting again. I sincerely hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and works on improving the facilities and service for future visitors.

featured_reviews.name: Trunali Mestry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Thrillville Entertainment Zone! The place is packed with fun activities for all age groups and is perfect for spending quality time with family and friends. The games and attractions are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the overall atmosphere is energetic and enjoyable.

A great destination for fun, adventure, and creating memorable moments. Highly recommended if you're looking for an exciting day out❤️✨💥

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Lanjekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited thrillvilla on my birthday which was planned by my girlfriend and I had the best time. The staff is very professional and helpful throughout the activities. We started with mirage museum where the staff helped us get the right angles for photos, then we went to splash and we loved that as well. The water could have been a little cleaner. Then came arena, rage room and gokarting. It was really amazing and very new experience. Finally I want to thank rumana for assisting me in getting my goggles back which I had forgotten there. P.S. I would suggest going here with a grp of 6-8 people and on weekdays to avoid rush.

featured_reviews.name: Travel with Maruf
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thrill Ville Entertainment Zone in Vasai is an absolute blast!
I had an amazing time with thrilling rides, great ambience, and friendly staff.
Special thanks to the amazing guards Samarth, Kartik, and Vishal for taking great care of us and making the experience even more fun. Perfect spot for a fun day out with friends or family. Everything was clean, safe, entertaining and beyond my expectations. I genuinely enjoyed every moment and felt so well taken care of. I’m already looking forward to coming back again, this time with my family and my students, so they too can experience the same amazing hospitality. See you again soon🤩
Highly recommend visiting if you’re in or around Mumbai!🙌
